head: f4579a41f
scope: delta: git diff 32ffa627f HEAD -- components/gpu-services components/interfaces; one gpu-services commit 9a79224a1 (A-14); interfaces change fc2a2b80d (ISPDKEnv::init_with_allowed) transitive only

drifted.spec_text: page-locks the specified host memory region via `cudaHostRegister` (enabling async GPU DMA) and registers it with SPDK via `spdk_mem_register` (enabling NVMe DMA)
drifted.actual: cudaHostRegister(PORTABLE) always; spdk_mem_register only when interfaces::is_spdk_env_active() at call time, else returns Ok(()) with CUDA pinning only

drifted.spec_text: unregisters memory from SPDK via `spdk_mem_unregister` then removes page-locking via `cudaHostUnregister`
drifted.actual: spdk_mem_unregister only when is_spdk_env_active() at call time; cudaHostUnregister always

drifted.spec_text: page-locks an existing host allocation via `cudaHostRegister` ... and registers it with SPDK via `spdk_mem_register` (enabling NVMe controllers to DMA directly to/from it)

specs.title: GPU P2P Server
aligned: unchanged; not touched by the delta (p2p_server sets up its own SPDK env, src/bin/p2p_server.rs:136-153)

interface_docs.doc_text: Register existing host memory as CUDA-pinned and SPDK DMA-capable. Calls `cudaHostRegister` ... then `spdk_mem_register` ... Returns an error if CUDA host registration or SPDK registration fails. / Calls `spdk_mem_unregister` then `cudaHostUnregister`.
interface_docs.actual: SPDK step conditional on is_spdk_env_active(); the Errors line is still literally true (SPDK registration can only fail when attempted)

observations: Flag is read at call time in each method independently: register while SPDK inactive, then unregister after SPDK became active, calls spdk_mem_unregister on a region SPDK never registered; non-zero rc returns Err before cudaHostUnregister (src/lib.rs:1222-1224), leaving the CUDA pin. No caller in the tree does this (dispatcher src/lib.rs:2256/2419, dispatcher-p2p src/lib.rs:1451/1735 register in initialize, unregister in shutdown). Covered by wording in P-1..P-4; no ALIGN proposed.

allocate_pinned_dma_buffer (src/lib.rs:1097-1130 -> src/dma.rs:259) still calls spdk_mem_register unguarded. Aligned with 001 FR-020 (registration is the method's purpose), but has the A-14 crash class without SPDK; dispatcher StagingPool::new calls it (components/dispatcher/src/pipeline.rs:219). Reachability in memory-tier-only mode is a dispatcher question; flagged for human review, no proposal here.
